method: Rows are the players on the club's own A-League Men squad page (or, where that page lags, named under Ins or Re-signings in the league's 2026-27 transfer centre) who also appear in at least one independent 2026-27 list: ESPN's roster, Transfermarkt's 26/27 squad or FotMob's squad. Name and position text as the club prints them. group stands when an independent source puts him in the same group; otherwise it is the group two independent hosts agree on, else null. birthDate only where two independent hosts give the same date (the club pages print age, not date), else null. minutes2025_26 is A-League Men 25/26 regular season minutes from Transfermarkt club pages, summed over clubs: 0 only where a page says "Not used during this season" (named in a matchday squad, never on); a "Not in squad during this season" entry is not counted (Transfermarkt prints it for players who joined after the season too), so minutes are null when he has no played or unused entry on any page. Minutes rest on one host, Transfermarkt, with no second source in this ledger (ESPN's 2025-26 gamelog came back empty when checked), so they are one-source values, unlike name, group and birthDate.
notes: 31 rows, one over the brief's band of 20 to 30: the club's squad page lists 31 players that ESPN or Transfermarkt also carry for 2026-27, and nobody is held out by guesswork. The bake round picks who sits out.

The offline market row for Panashe Madanha at Adelaide is stale: the league's transfer centre lists him under Adelaide's Outs and Western Sydney's Ins, and he is a row in western-sydney-wanderers.json.
